title: Filter Dispatch Table: function & member pointers
hints: applyN: guard against a null pointer first (`if (!f)`). Calling a null function pointer is UB.

makeFilter: build a `static const std::map<std::string, PointPredicate (*)(double)>` whose values are capture-less lambdas (they convert to function pointers). Each one returns a lambda capturing `param` by value.
applyPipeline: skip empty stages with `if (!stage) continue;`, and use std::all_of over the remaining stages for each point.
